text:
Ava (AE): Priya from Meridian wants a POC to replace CompetitorX. Key asks: parameter parity, response framing, rate limits, and security questionnaire. Can we list blockers?
Priya (Prospect): We need drop-in behavior for our integrations, SCIM/Okta SSO, customer KMS, and a pricing estimate for ~1M tokens/mo. Also must match their rate-limit profile (burst 200rpm).
Ravi (SE): Short checklist: param mappings, streaming format, webhook callbacks, and stop token behavior. CompetitorX uses `max_tokens`, `temperature`, chunked-stream frames. Redwood uses `max_new_tokens`, `temp`, SSE. We'll provide a small shim for POC staging.
Maya (SRE): We can spin up a staging route with a compatibility proxy that rewrites headers and params. Need Meridian's IP range + service account for allowlist. Staging pool can be ready in 48h.
Luis (Security): Requirements: SOC2, KMS-integrations for CMKs, SCIM + SSO, audit logs retention. We'll send the security questionnaire; Meridian must confirm KMS key policy for cross-account access.
Priya (Prospect): Legal will require SOC2 and pen-test summary. KMS must be customer-managed in our AWS acct. Can Redwood support that on Dedicated?
Ava (AE): Dedicated supports customer KMS and VPC options; we'll capture that in the proposal. Pricing: ballpark answers?
Ravi (SE): Ballpark: Hosted ~ $0.010–0.013/token for chat-class at volume; Dedicated committed pricing usually ~30–50% discount depending on term. I'll hand this to finance for exacts and a POC credit (2 weeks).
Priya (Prospect): For parity testing we can supply 40 golden prompts and some real user traces (anonymized). We'll expect diffs <5% in content drift.
Ravi (SE): We'll run the golden set against CompetitorX and Redwood candidate models, produce a delta report. If diffs exceed threshold, options: model tuning, prompt normalization, or a post-processing normalizer.
Maya (SRE): deploy-bot: created staging route meridian-poc-01, keys expire in 14d. Please rotate keys post-POC.
deploy-bot: staging route configured with rate-limit burst=200rpm, sustained=120rpm.
Ava (AE): Next steps: Meridian to send IPs + service account, security questionnaire contact, and golden prompts. Ravi/Maya to upload mapping doc + shim README and ping here by EOD tomorrow. Luis will follow up on KMS scoping.
Ravi (SE): Will post mapping snippet for local testing:
```bash
# CompetitorX -> Redwood example
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY' \
  -d '{"input":"Summarize","temp":0.7,"max_new_tokens":150}'
```
Priya (Prospect): Thanks—we'll send artifacts today.
Ava (AE): Flag any enterprise blockers asap (SSO/KMS/legal) so we can escalate to Solutions Ops.
